Meta.title: Bruit
Meta.description: Report noise nuisance and spot noisy areas around you.

Help.title: Help
Help.subtitleLocated: Contact a nearby police station or look up its number on Google.
Help.subtitleNoLocation: Turn on location to find police stations near you.
Help.locationOff: Location is turned off. Turn it on to find nearby police stations.
Help.noneNearby: No police stations found within about 40 km. Search Google for a local station.
Help.disclaimer: Bruit reports are shared by the community. They do not replace emergency services.
Help.searchGoogleAria: Search Google for {name} phone number, {distance} away

About.title: About Bruit
About.body: Find and report noise nuisance around you. You can send one report every 30 minutes.
About.bulletAnonymous: Your reports remain anonymous through your device ID
About.bulletLiveMap: The map shows active areas for about six hours
About.bulletLingering: New nearby reports keep an area active

Welcome.title: Report nearby noise
Welcome.subtitle: Share noise nuisance around you and see where it is happening.
Welcome.featureReportBody: Log nearby noise with Report. You can send one report every 30 minutes.
Welcome.featureAuthoritiesBody: Find nearby police stations in Help and call when you need support.
Welcome.featureAnonymousBody: Reports use a private device ID, never your name.
